messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to eu1: inference v2.36.0 -> v2.37.0 (10%). commit 7f6e5d. post-deploy smoke probes running.

nina: Heads-up 1m after rollout start synth watchdog flagged elevated accept-queue drops on 2 hosts; short 502 bursts on /v1/generate.

sre-tom: Per-host: eu1-node-4 and eu1-node-9 show accept queue overflow counters rising; no pod restarts. p95 increased from 320ms -> 1.1s on canary.

ops-hemant: Suggest pause + region pin to stable and quarantine the two hosts from LB while we collect traces. Prefer quarantine over full rollback.

release-claudia: Pausing rollout now. No further batches.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-claudia.

ops-hemant: Runbook snippet (infra-admin):
```bash
routectl set-route --region eu1 --target release:v2.36.0 --weight 100 --reason "post-deploy accept-queue drops"
lbctl remove-backend --region eu1 --backend eu1-node-4
lbctl remove-backend --region eu1 --backend eu1-node-9
```

nina: After diversion synth errors dropped to baseline within 45s. No customer incidents reported. Captured ss/netstat from nodes and flamegraphs uploaded to INF-4720.

sre-tom: Initial hypothesis: new listener socket backlog default too low for this codepath. Propose temporary mitigation: increase envoy listen backlog and add per-host accept-queue metric to canary gating. Filing INF-4720.

product-rafa: Thanks. Please add a short note to release timeline: "eu1 paused and routed to v2.36.0 after accept-queue drops observed in canary; hosts quarantined; INF-4720 opened."

release-claudia: Noted. Marking release as "paused - region reverted". Owner INF-4720=@sre-tom. Closing thread for now.
